## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today? Describe
the use case, not just the proposed API.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. A sketch of the API or behavior is helpful:

```cpp
// ...
```

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed, and why they fall short (including doing it by hand
with the current primitives).

## Additional context

Related work in other task systems / engines, performance considerations, or
anything else relevant. See [docs/TODO.md](../../docs/TODO.md) — the feature may
already be on the roadmap.
